blocks.text: Ship beautiful, performant websites with design-driven development

Framer has evolved from a prototyping tool into one of the most capable website builders for startups that care about design quality. It combines a Figma-like design experience with real publishing power, letting you create sites that look like they cost six figures to build.

The performance story is compelling. Framer sites are server-rendered and optimized out of the box, often scoring higher on Core Web Vitals than hand-coded alternatives. For SEO-conscious startups, that translates directly into better search rankings.

What makes Framer particularly valuable for growing teams is its component system. Build once, reuse everywhere - and when you update a component, every instance updates automatically. This keeps your brand consistent as you scale from five pages to fifty.
Design directly on the canvas with familiar tools and real-time preview
Responsive layouts that adapt intelligently across breakpoints
Dynamic content collections with built-in multi-language support
Server-rendered pages with automatic image optimization and code splitting
Reusable components with variants and overrides for consistent design at scale
Drop in React components and custom code when you need advanced functionality

Framer produces some of the fastest, most visually polished sites we have seen from a no-code tool. If your brand depends on standing out visually, Framer gives you that edge without needing a full development team.
Our team can integrate Framer into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
